messages.subject: R/qtlcharts problem
parts:
Dear Professor Karl,

I am trying to use R/qtlcharts to plot mapthis data into a RStudio presentation.

Here is it what I was trying:

Plot mapping
========================================================
```{r, include=FALSE}
pull.map(mapthis)
iplotMap(mapthis)
plot.missing(mapthis)
```


I get the following error:

Error in file(con, "rb") : cannot open the connection

I am using R version 3.3.2 (2016-10-31)

Could you please suggest any fix for the problem ?

Thank you.

messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] R/qtlcharts problem
parts:
It's hard to tell without seeing the full context. Could you post the rest of the file?

If you use `include=FALSE` as a chunk option, I think it won't include those two plots at all. But I wouldn't expect the "cannot open the connection" error from that.

karl
